page.layout: One printed page, one text block of full lines, no margin notes except a small mark at the right edge of line 1 and a few faint marks at the left edge, which are not text. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. Last line "prope" set right-aligned, a catchword-like continuation at the foot right.

main_text.p: non vt redderent : nonnuli, quod ambitiosi essent : quidam , ne non viderentur. Sola quippe ambitio, vt nomine virtutis ac affinitate obrepit, ita affectatur; neque cuiquam satis placet, nisi cum apparet. Omnium aetatum, saeculorum, temporum, Annales evoluantur. Ne de Graecis aliisque gentibus jam dicam, quibus nunquam ad victoriam praetextus , nunquam artes , fraudes, strophae defuêre : Populi Romani, celeberrimi, sanctissimi, grauissimi res expendantur. non reperietur, qui non arma sumpserit vt triumpharet , vt pomoeria diduceret , vt rebus, quas gessisset, frueretur. quanquam ea specie, vt à defensione sociorum, ad imperium terrarum & oppressionem caeterorum clam progressi, soli fere ab aequitate commendentur. Ate omnia sic gesta, vt nec inchoante bellum causae aequitas deesset, nec gerente, Deus aequitati. Vota omnia ac coepta antecessit pietas, nec defuit successus. Defuisset autem quomodo, cum nonn deesset qui fortunae ac naturae solus imperat? quae ex praescripto ejus imperantibus ministrant. Jam, cum nihil aeque bellum moderetur ac deliberatio define; finem ipsum ac euentus rerum ita direxisti, vt difficultates omnes ante exigeres quam superares. Superasti autem, quia tecum & cum Deo exegisti. ad quem frequentissimo accessu ac alloquiorum vsu, prope
Stray marks at the left margin are not printed text and are not transcribed.

page.notes: Line 1 of the page begins mid-sentence ("non vt redderent"), so the paragraph continues from the previous page. The running head reads "DANIELIS HEINSII" with page number 114. Doubtful readings: "nonn deesset" (line 'Defuisset autem quomodo'), probably a printed "non deesset" with a doubled n; kept as printed. The word "prope" at the foot right is a catchword, and is also the last word of the text. The paragraph is not split because no indent appears in the block.
